mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ORDERS ( ORDER_ID, USER_ID, CUSTOMER_NAME, PRODUCT_ID, PAYMENT_METHOD, TOTAL_AMOUNT, STATUS, ORDER_DATE, PAYMENT_KEY ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{customerName}, #{productId}, #{paymentMethod}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{paymentKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT o.*, p.PRODUCT_NAME as orderName FROM ORDERS o JOIN PRODUCT p ON o.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID WHERE o.ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
